title: Input symbol in a scan configuration
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, state option $q$, output word $o$, and position $i\le |x|$, the symbol read by the input head in the scan configuration at position $i+1$ is the $i$th entry of $x$, interpreted as an optional symbol.
